races.paceDynamic: Hurt You Never will take this field along as the only confirmed front runner, with Keldeo, Blue Lakota and Harry Mole likely to track him in the early positions. The pace should be sustainable rather than frantic given limited early speed, allowing the large contingent of hold-up horses to get organized behind. This moderate tempo will suit patient riders who can time their runs, as the race will develop into a sprint finish from the 2f pole. The race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can quicken off a solid pace, with prominent racers also well-placed to strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and the field bunches up approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows patient horses to get perfect positions and unleash late kicks. Hold-up specialists with proven finishing speed will have ideal conditions to strike from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Keldeo and Blue Lakota can secure perfect stalking positions behind Hurt You Never
scenarios.body: These prominent racers avoid the scramble behind and have first run on the leader when the pace lifts. Their tactical positioning gives them the jump on the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Hurt You Never gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace leaves enough in the tank for a sustained drive to the line. Late closers struggle to peg back the advantage from such a position of strength.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the lack of early speed creates a crawling pace through the first half
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint where early position trumps finishing kick. Horses close to the pace have decisive advantages over those trapped at the back.

watchPoints.text: Hurt You Never could get too easy a lead if no one goes with him early, making him very difficult to peg back
Imperial Guard's 210-day absence is a major concern for any horse trying to win first time back from such a layoff
The Midgley pair Fierce and Speeding Bullet both arrive in good form and could provide the stable with a strong hand
Track the early positioning of Blue Lakota and Keldeo as their prominent styles could prove crucial in a slowly-run race
Wen Moon's recent winning form makes him dangerous if he can secure a clear run from his hold-up position

races.paceDynamic: Call Me Betty, Magic Boy, and Iris Dancer will ensure a strong gallop from the start with all three confirmed front runners likely to dispute the early lead. This will create a demanding pace over 6f that will test stamina reserves, particularly with Magic Boy showing excellent recent form on good going and Call Me Betty needing to bounce back from a poor last run. The sustained gallop will set up the race perfectly for hold-up horses who can time their challenges late. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers and prominent racers with tactical speed who can avoid the early pace battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners go too fast early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The strong pace will find out the leaders in the final furlong, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired front runners. Ran Amok and Surprised have the perfect profiles to capitalise on this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers can settle just off the pace and avoid the early battle
scenarios.body: A horse like Counting Cards or Mr Dreamseller can track the leaders without getting involved in the pace duel then strike decisively. Their tactical positioning gives them the perfect launching pad for a winning move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Magic Boy can establish a clear lead and dictate more sensible fractions
scenarios.body: Magic Boy's excellent recent record on good going could see him control the pace better than his rivals and hold on grimly. His proven ability at this distance on similar going makes him the most likely leader to last home.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Arrive Too Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is more moderate than expected with the leaders going steady early
scenarios.body: Without enough pace to aim at, the hold-up horses may find their finishing kicks blunted by a tactical affair. The prominent racers who stayed closer to the action will have the advantage in a sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Magic Boy and Call Me Betty clash heads early as both are natural front runners for the same trainer

Check if the three confirmed front runners actually commit to the early lead or one drops back tactically
Observe whether Raft Up can repeat his recent course wins when facing this stronger field
Watch for Surprised to be delivered late wide of horses given his hold-up style under Mulrennan

races.paceDynamic: Lord stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the gates, likely getting an uncontested lead with Haarar the only prominent runner sitting behind him. The extensive hold-up brigade of As Fast As Wind, Billy No Mates, Ashdown Forest, Swinging London, Cascade Hall and Charlie Darling will create a bunched field tracking the pace. With minimal early pressure on Lord, he can control the tempo and potentially kick clear, making this a tactical affair that will favour the pace angle over the hold-up merchants who need a strong gallop to be effective.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lord Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Lord gets his preferred steady tempo and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: Lord can dictate terms from the front and prove hard to peg back, while any prominent runner like Haarar can track him into contention. The hold-up horses will struggle without a strong pace to close into.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with Haarar or others pressing Lord
scenarios.body: This creates the conditions the closers need, allowing As Fast As Wind and Billy No Mates to unleash their finishing kicks. The front runners pay for their exertions in a cavalry charge finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Loki Produces Big Effort
scenarios.trigger: If Loki shows his class despite the 199-day layoff and uncertain running style
scenarios.body: His superior ability on ratings could shine through with PJ McDonald able to place him perfectly from an uncertain position. The pace scenario becomes secondary to pure class assertion.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the outsiders finds significant improvement from recent form
scenarios.body: Horses like Cascade Hall or Charlie Darling could capitalise on a messy pace scenario where the fancied runners cancel each other out. The tactical nature creates upset potential.

watchPoints.text: Lord could steal this if allowed to dictate a steady tempo without serious early pressure from the field

The good ground throughout the card suggests consistent conditions favouring those who have shown form on similar surfaces

races.paceDynamic: Lunar Melody is the confirmed early pace angle and will set a sustainable tempo without pressure from the break. Dark Sovereign and Wezzeer may track closely in prominent positions, but neither has shown genuine pace-forcing tendencies. The moderate gallop will suit horses that can travel kindly and produce a turn of foot, with the real action delayed until the final 2f as the field bunches up. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace who can position handy and kick - hold-up horses face a significant disadvantage with limited pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Lunar Melody dictates uncontested fractions through halfway
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo allows prominent runners to travel comfortably before the sprint finish, negating stamina doubts. Horses positioned within 3-4 lengths turning for home can unleash their finishing kick effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Dash from Hold-Up
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle stages creating a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the strong tempo they need in the final 3f to showcase their finishing speed. The bunched field provides cover and racing room for swooping challengers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Pace Duel
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Lunar Melody for the early lead unexpectedly
scenarios.body: A genuine pace battle emerges as prominent runners get drawn into speed, setting up the race for closers. The honest gallop stretches the field and creates opportunities for patient tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Weak Pace Favours Class
scenarios.trigger: If the entire field settles into a pedestrian crawl throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of tempo becomes a pure test of class and acceleration from the 2f pole. Higher-rated newcomers with unknown ability can capitalise on superior breeding and fitness.

Wezzeer's ability to handle the step up to 7f while carrying a penalty after recent 6f success

races.paceDynamic: Dandy Orton will look to take this field along from the front, but with his modest OR 46 rating and 121lbs, he's unlikely to set a scorching gallop over this mile trip. The entire field consists of hold-up horses, meaning Dandy Orton will get an uncontested lead and dictate comfortable fractions throughout. With no natural pace pressers to challenge early, this sets up as a steady-run affair that will turn into a sprint finish where the best staying power and turn of foot will prevail. This race shape strongly favours the classier hold-up horses who can quicken from off the pace, particularly those with proven form at the trip and rating advantages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Classy Closers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Dandy Orton sets modest fractions uncontested to the home turn
scenarios.body: The race becomes a staying test where superior class tells as the field bunches for a sprint finish. Higher-rated hold-up horses like Thankfully Simmy and Too Darn Spicy can use their rating advantages to outgun the moderate pace-setter.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Dandy Orton goes too slow early and the field gets bunched approaching the turn
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the furlong pole where horses with recent form spikes can capitalise. Fresh legs and those who've shown speed recently get first run on the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If the good going plays faster than expected and Dandy Orton gets away with very soft fractions
scenarios.body: His light weight and uncontested lead prove decisive as the closers leave their run too late on ground that doesn't suit late flourishes. The pace-setter has enough left to resist the late charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Quickens Unexpectedly
scenarios.trigger: If several hold-up horses move simultaneously turning for home creating a fast finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a stamina test where horses struggle to quicken off the strong pace. Those with proven staying power and fitness advantages come through late.

Several runners including Hatamoto and Royal Baroness face stamina questions stepping up to this mile distance
The good going conditions favour horses with proven form on similar surfaces, eliminating several with limited good going experience

races.paceDynamic: William Dewhirst will be the primary pace-setter with This Farh, Native Instinct, Vince Le Prince and Bay Breeze all tracking closely in the prominent positions. The early gallop will be solid but not excessive with only one natural front-runner, allowing the pace to build steadily through the middle sections. A large group of hold-up horses including Green Pursuit, Black Storm, Judicature, They All Know Me, Detective and Wish This will be held back for late challenges. This pace dynamic strongly favours the hold-up horses who can finish fastest off what should be a searching but not brutal early tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If William Dewhirst goes too fast early trying to dominate or the prominent group engages in a speed duel
scenarios.body: The pace will be unsustainable allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past a weakened field in the final furlong. Green Pursuit and Black Storm are perfectly positioned to capitalize with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Slow Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses settle too quietly behind William Dewhirst creating pedestrian fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f marker where early positioning matters more than finishing kick. This Farh and Native Instinct can use their prominent positions to steal a march on the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Even Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If William Dewhirst sets sensible fractions with the field staying together until the final 2f
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of pure ability rather than tactics with the best handicapped horses prevailing. Native Instinct's recent form improvement and Black Storm's consistency make them the logical beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If William Dewhirst gets loose on the lead with soft fractions and the field fails to close
scenarios.body: The pace-setter will have enough left to resist late challenges especially if Paul Mulrennan can dictate terms. William Dewhirst's stamina-laden pedigree suits this scenario perfectly.
